answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 22338 Country: India Title: I want to know tabeer of my dream that everytime i see a dream that i was on the railway station and my freinds and sometime my parents with me and every time i miss the train what does this dream actually mean? Question: I want to know tabeer of my dream that everytime i see a dream that i was on the railway station and my freinds and sometime my parents with me and every time i miss the train what does this dream actually mean? Answer ID: 22338 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1077/818/H=1431) It is a nice dream. It indicates towards the impermanency of the world and its glitters, as well as there is inattentiveness to good deeds on your behalf, you should pay attention to it and reform the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
